literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes a truncated BSG construct (lacking the N-terminal 100 amino acids, i.e. residues 1–100, which removes the signal peptide and the first ~79 residues of the extracellular domain) cloned into pCDNA3 with an HA sequence for a co-immunoprecipitation / pull-down assay. Two independent disqualifiers apply: (a) the HA tag position is completely unstated — the clip gives no residue number, no terminus, and no junction, so insert_after_residue cannot be pinned; (b) the construct is not full-length and membrane-anchored, which is a hard requirement. Even setting aside the truncation, the rules explicitly exclude any construct 'whose tag POSITION is unstated.' No other ledger lines exist. Zero sites is the correct answer.
